item.title: Far-right Israeli lawmaker damages Palestinian memorial with sledgehammer
item.description: Zvi Sukkot's actions have drawn widespread condemnation, including from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

item.title: Trump says all mines cleared from Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran has closed the vital waterway since the beginning of the conflict causing wild fluctuations in oil prices worldwide.

item.title: Musk's SpaceX to build $100bn launch facility in Louisiana
item.description: It will be the firm's biggest site yet and aims to send rockets to space in 2029.

item.title: Door was locked at Pakistan hospital where fire killed 14 babies, witnesses say
item.description: The hospital tells the BBC the ward door was not locked but manned with security guards, to protect the babies.

item.title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
item.description: The latest escalation in an ongoing trade war between the US and Canada will see new levies on goods from steel to furniture, fresh tuna and makeup.

item.title: Radiation link in flight attendant's breast cancer, French court finds
item.description: Former Air France stewardess Sophie Lainault has had her cancer recognised as an occupational disease.

item.title: Germany's Merz warns attackers will 'pay price' after drone incident
item.description: A drone attack on Leipzig Airport highlights the "very real threat" faced by the country, the German chancellor says.
